descriptions.d16c_hud_text_load_8011b010: Look up and retain the FE.Font service for the duration of the call and set its scale to (-1, 0); load the FE.Font text resource, retain it as the HUD font (+28) releasing the previous one; load the Text.Backing.Green resource into the backing handle (+32); attach the font with mode 1; then release the looked-up service.
